_about.purpose: Golden dataset for the weighted lead scorer: human-reviewable gold points per attribute, so judge accuracy can be measured as per-attribute MAE plus email-decision accuracy.
_about.icp: company_icp.txt (multi-agent orchestration seller). Gold scores are ICP-specific.
_about.rubric: backend/config/lead_qualification_tasks_weighted.yaml (role 15, seniority 5, size 10, presence 10, cultural fit 30, use case 20, engagement 10).
_about.status: DRAFT gold scores written by an assistant from general knowledge; a human must review every record, especially real-company facts.
_about.borderline_excluded: Leads whose gold total is 65-75 (the app's Borderline band) are left out: the salesperson decides those, so the eval only scores clear cases.
_about.repeats: Leads with a repeats field are scored that many times to measure reliability (score spread and flips across 70).
